mods.title: FNF: SONIC JAM!
mods.description: Welcome to SONIC JAMJAMMIN' NEW WEEKTake on the World's Most Famous Hedgehog in WEEK SONIC, a 3-song original level with songs inspired by the rich soundtracks of Sonic CD, Sonic R,Sonic Adventure, and beyond! Revisit a classic locale, experience dazzling hand-drawn cutscenes, and rhyme at super-sonic speeds! Can you keep up?PLAYABLE SONIC CAMPAIGNDr. Eggman's got a new path to world domination-- the POWER of MUSIC! Using his greatest creation, METAL SONIC, the Doctor's taking over the city's musical culture to harness its unlimited musical power. What's worse... is that they're convinced METAL SONIC is the REAL SONIC! But Sonic's not the slacker type. Take back the city's music and clear Sonic's name through intricately crafted 'Sonic Mixes' of FNF's unforgettable soundtrack. With 10+ remixes lovingly created from the ground up, you can check out a fresh, distinct take on Friday Night Funkin's music inspired by New Jack Swing, RNB, 90's House, Rock, Hip Hop, Chiptune, and many more. Face off against the worst of the worst, bring Metal Sonic's reign to an end, and free the spirit of music in Sonic's campaign.GO FOR PERFECTWhen you're playing as Sonic, simply hitting all the notes won't be enough for those brag-worthy P ranks. On top of beating a song flawlessly, you'll need to style on your enemies with a brand new taunt system. After hitting a combo, you'll be able to chain taunts to the rhythm until your next turn. Pull off a sweet chain, and you'll get crazy bonuses that'll shoot you straight to the top! Every SICK note you hit gets added to your SCORE, so be sure to rack up enough for a massive score bonus at the end. Make a name for yourself on the charts as the most stylish MC alive!

mods.title: VS Hex Mod (V3 / THE EVENT UPDATE)
mods.description: If you open the game and you're in default Friday Night Funkin' you need to access the mod via the Mod Menu. To enter mod menu in-game you need to access Debug Menu by clicking a button you've assigned to it in Controls.The basketball-loving TV Head returns for a third time! This time, on court! Join Boyfriend and Hex as they get through a sports match for charity, although... who knows, someone might interrupt this festival of joy and hospitality.The Event Update / V3 is available both as a "Game + Mod" bundle and "Mod Only" downloads, the contents include:A new story week - "Event X"!7 new freeplay songs + 10 new remixes, including old song versions, thus totaling the unique song count to 30 songs!Lower difficulties available for some songs with modcharts.Base Game / VSlice compatibility, the mod was reworked from the ground up to work on base game engine.New UI for every menu, including Story Mode, Freeplay, Gallery, Jukebox, Options and Credits. If you open the game and you're in default Friday Night Funkin' you need to access the mod via the Mod Menu. To enter mod menu in-game you need to access Debug Menu by clicking a button you've assigned to it in Controls.The "Game + Mod" bundle allows you to play the mod now, without additional steps.If you download "Mod Only" version, please extract contents of the zip to Base Game's "mods" folder. To enter mod menu in-game you need to access Debug Menu by clicking a button you've assigned to it in Controls. The Mod Menu Preview #4 version of Base Game and above is required for the mod to work. This version can be found in a link listed below:[Link currently unavailable, once Funkin' Crew releases Preview #4 the link will appear here.]IMPORTANT: THE MOD IS FORWARD COMPATIBLE WITH FUTURE VERSIONS OF V-SLICEThe mobile version of the mod, alongside tutorial on how to install it, will be available once Funkin' Crew releases mobile support for preview versions of the app, at a later date.If you wanna listen to Hexcess, an album consisting of songs from Full Week Update, here they are uploaded onto Spotify and Apple Music!: https://open.spotify.com/album/7ATqQPKkEt6xdPU1uPkJPx?si=6bf9a28a16354774 https://music.apple.com/us/artist/yingyang48/1562894415If you wanna listen to Hextravaganza, an album consisting of songs from Full Week Update, here they are uploaded onto Spotify, Apple Music and Soundcloud!: https://open.spotify.com/album/3Zb3Hvk89POlwrx8nQLL7ohttps://music.apple.com/us/album/hextravaganza-ep/1563141570https://soundcloud.com/yingyang48/sets/hextravaganzaIf you wanna listen to Hexperience, an album consisting of songs from The Weekend Update and remaining songs from the mod, here they are uploaded onto Spotify and Apple Music!: https://open.spotify.com/album/6m6og2zeiHn7bqFe9SGprqhttps://music.apple.com/us/album/hexperience/1603683226Source code:https://github.com/Kade-github/Hex-V3
